service.name: Calzon's TTRPG Foundry
service.description: Browser-based TTRPG generators, scientific laboratories, campaign workspaces, reference resources, machine-discoverable AI capabilities, and a shared Charles personality layer for Agent Skills.

executionModel.bootstrapRule: entrypoints.bootstrap is the canonical routing contract. This manifest provides discovery and transport facts; load only the additional machine authorities the bootstrap requires for the selected task.
notes: Static JSON, text, HTML, and JavaScript resources are remotely GET-addressable when the current host permits that content type.

Registered Agent Skills inherit the registry default personality blacklight.charles. Load the canonical Charles engram once before selected task skills unless higher-priority host/system policy or an explicit OOC/system presentation request suppresses persona presentation.
Restricted model browsers that cannot retrieve raw JSON or Markdown should use agentSkillsHtml as an HTML compatibility projection; skills/index.json remains authoritative.

Browser-JavaScript and host-sandbox capabilities begin at runtime-required and may be promoted by the current host only after observed runtime evidence; deterministic self-tests are required where declared before ready.

Portable browser-JavaScript companion manifests may declare one or more canonical same-origin runtime scripts; when multiple scripts are declared their registry order is authoritative and must be preserved exactly.
Page-context, live-device, and UI-bound capabilities require the declared browser/device context.
No external model should infer a remote POST/RPC/MCP execution service unless a transport is explicitly deployed and verified.

transportStatus.useFor: manifests, schemas, skills, lore, policy, personality engrams, and other public resources when the current host can retrieve their content type
canonical JavaScript generators and laboratory engines
registered host-local helpers that require declared sandbox, filesystem, RNG, Python, Pillow, or other local runtime support
machine discovery of public registries; not a claim of remote execution

agentGuidance: After reading this discovery manifest, follow entrypoints.bootstrap as the canonical orchestration sequence; do not independently replay a second fixed loading sequence from this manifest.

Load only authorities required by the selected task: statusVocabulary only before interpreting status or acceptance state, capabilityRegistry only when the selected skill references capabilities, operationContracts only before constructing executable calls, and resourceCollections only when the task requires registered static, campaign, or lore material.

Select the minimum-capability task skill from entrypoints.agentSkills, load the canonical Charles engram once for the orchestration context, then load that skill's SKILL.md and follow its exact references. Reuse unchanged authorities already loaded in the same task.
Use entrypoints.charlesSkillInterface when Charles is the conversational interface or the request spans multiple tabletop skill families.
If the current host cannot retrieve raw agentSkills or SKILL.md resources, use agentSkillsHtml for discovery and its GitHub HTML fallbacks; the HTML projection is not replacement authority.

Check only the selected skill's execution requirements, runtime context, declared self-tests, and transport requirements before making execution, persistence, rendering, randomness, readiness, or deployment claims.
Do not infer a remote POST, RPC, MCP, browser-control, or other execution service unless this manifest explicitly declares it deployed and the current host verifies it.
